description: This Java source file defines the `CustomerController` class, part of a Spring MVC-based web application. It handles administrative customer management functions such as viewing, editing, saving customer data, managing customer attributes, listing customers with pagination, and resetting customer passwords. The controller interacts with various services for data access and operations, and defines request mappings for different customer-related endpoints within the admin interface.

classes.name: CustomerController
classes.description: Controller class managing customer-related administrative functions such as viewing, editing, listing, attribute management, and password resetting within the admin interface.

methods.name: displayCustomer
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display customer details or load the customer editing form if an ID is provided.

methods.name: saveCustomer
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save or update customer information, including validation and related data processing.

methods.name: pageCustomers
methods.description: Handles POST requests to provide a paginated list of customers as JSON, supporting filters like email, name, and country.

methods.name: resetPassword
methods.description: Handles POST requests to reset a customer's password, generate a new password, save it, and send a notification email.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Private helper method to set up menu items for the admin UI.

methods.name: getCustomerOptions
methods.description: Private helper method to populate customer options and attributes into the model for display/editing.
